projectDescription: A lightweight Progressive Web Application (PWA) designed for managing bounty-based prize rewards and opening objective-linked quests.
projectFeatures: Streamlined tracking for daily tasks, recurring bounties, and multi-objective quests with real-time progress calculations.
Gamified point economy featuring compounding daily milestone bonuses and instant redemption for custom prizes.
Robust account isolation with JWT-based session security and strict database-level data separation.
Installable Progressive Web App (PWA) support with a responsive dashboard and focus-oriented goal sorting.

projectDescription: A robust personal knowledge management platform for organizing notes, links, and documents into shareable, context-aware collections.
projectFeatures: Streamlined storage for text notes, links, code snippets, and task lists.
Organize knowledge into 'slices' with tag-based search and Gemini-powered context descriptions.
Secure sharing features for collaborative knowledge bases via public links.

projectDescription: A browser-based precision drawing game that challenges users to draw a perfect circle, utilizing real-time feedback and scoring.
projectFeatures: Real-time precision tracking and accuracy feedback.
Dynamic score calculation based on geometric circle approximation.
Minimalist, performant UI built for a smooth drawing experience.
